g.text: Persisted Plan / Ticket Lifecycle — Fresh Workers, Shared Plan Branch
Complete Plan Markdown contracts saved + read back
Normal stopping point; Plan record checkpointed
Separate fresh verifier unless one-Ticket exact-scope coalescing applies
Authorized commit / push / Plan PR actions
Verified merge fact: effective Plan/Tickets done
Same-requirement supplements update the original Ticket;
add a Ticket only for a distinct behavior boundary.
Independent requirements always start a new Plan,
even while another Plan is unmerged.
The main agent directly dispatches fresh owners and verifiers.
Every worker is a leaf; no worker spawns another worker.
Codex uses fork_turns="none"; other hosts need equivalent fresh context.
All active roles count against actual host capacity; main + one worker needs two slots.
Dependent Tickets may prepare read-only; writes wait for prerequisite independent PASS.
Batch checkpoints preserve accepted state and all failure evidence.
Normally a separate fresh verifier checks the entire current Plan scope.
One new Sol/high check may cover both gates only for one Ticket with identical
scope, artifact/version, configuration, and deployment surface.
Never reuse a verifier after scope or surface changes.
then new verifier; retain failed evidence
yes; fresh owner and verifier for next Ticket
later functionality uses a new Plan
